title: Need help deciding on chunk size for financial PDFs
content: I'm working with lengthy financial reports. I tried a chunk size of 1000 tokens, but the model often misses key figures that are split across the boundary. Should I use semantic chunking instead? The documents are very structured.

title: Why does my RAG agent hallucinate with good context?
content: My retrieval seems fine (high precision score), but the LLM still fabricates answers. I'm using GPT-3.5. Is it a prompting issue, or should I invest in a better reranker? I heard Cohere's reranker is good for filtering high-noise results.
